description: Stores the Bing Webmaster Tools API key of the Organiq account (one key per account; it serves every property with a Bing site set by set_bing_site). The key is generated by the user in Bing Webmaster Tools under Settings → API access ("Configurações → Acesso à API") and pasted in the chat; it is stored encrypted, never returned by any tool and not logged. Format: 16–128 letters, digits, "-" or "_". Only an owner or admin of the account can store it (insufficient_scope otherwise). Returns { set, setAt }. Needs the write scope (mcp:write). Use it after set_bing_site, or when get_bing_performance / check_connection report the key missing. Guide: https://organiqgeo.com/connect/bing. / Grava, cifrada, a chave da API do Bing gerada pelo humano no portal do Bing e colada no chat.

key.description: API key generated in Bing Webmaster Tools (Settings → API access) and pasted by the user.
